This channel is dedicated to teaching simple, intentional touch that calms the nervous system, reduces stress, and deepens connection without making massage complicated. 

Here you'll learn easy partner massage routines and the science behind how touch effects our relationship health, emotional regulation, and our bodies.

Whether you're massaging your partner, loved one, or spouse, this channel will help you to feel confident using touch to help them unwind, relax, and feel supported.

Learn More inside my program 'Massage Made Simple' Linked in my bio!
💌Malietherapeutic@gmail.com
